items.problem: D1: Bootstrap omitted externally linked shared source, XAML, and assets.
items.evidence: Turn 2 reported only 10 copied files; Store.csproj contains 19 supported external Include+Link items, and turns 5-23 manually reconstructed them.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, SharedContent, and external Include handling.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap used only a recursive directory walk beneath -Source.
items.proposed_fix: Parse legacy project Include+Link items, expand common project properties, and copy supported files to Link paths before rewrite/triage.
items.generalizes: Linked shared code and content are common in UWP solutions and SDK samples.

items.problem: D2: The skill instructed agents to run nonexistent `winapp build`.
items.evidence: Turn 24 failed with "'build' was not matched".
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for winapp build and dotnet build.
items.root_cause: Build instructions were stale relative to the installed CLI and the validator's native dotnet build.
items.proposed_fix: Use native dotnet build consistently; reserve winapp for package registration/launch.
items.generalizes: Every migration must compile, and the command fails independently of app features.

items.problem: D3: Validation missed a broken local ResourceDictionary URI, causing startup failure and all seven scored feature failures.
items.evidence: Final App.xaml references /Styles/Styles.xaml while only root Styles.xaml exists; turns 39/46 report 0xc000027b in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll; migration-score.json marks all seven features fail.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 for ResourceDictionary Source/path validation.
items.root_cause: No deterministic check ensured local merged dictionaries existed at package-relative Source paths.
items.proposed_fix: Validate local ResourceDictionary Source values before build/launch and report the referring file/line.
items.generalizes: Moved shared dictionaries and package-root resource URIs recur in UWP project conversions.

items.problem: D4: Test-AppLaunch could not discover native dotnet's default bin/Debug output.
items.evidence: Turn 32 built successfully to bin/Debug; turn 33 immediately reported no output under bin/x64/Debug.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Only bin/<arch>/Debug and bin/<rid>/Debug were searched.
items.root_cause: Layout discovery assumed an explicit Platform build.
items.generalizes: Native dotnet build commonly uses the unqualified bin/Debug path.

items.problem: D5: Migration patterns did not cover NETSDK1022 duplicate XAML Page items.
items.evidence: Turn 25 failed because the agent added explicit Page Include entries to an SDK-style project.
items.skill_search: Searched MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for NETSDK1022, EnableDefaultPageItems, and duplicate Page.
items.root_cause: The project guidance did not state that SDK-style WinUI projects include local XAML pages by default.
items.proposed_fix: Add a compact common-error mapping: remove explicit local Page includes unless default items are intentionally disabled.
items.generalizes: Explicit UWP Page lists frequently collide with SDK default items.

items.problem: D6: Bootstrap and validator disagreed about the no-deferred-items sentinel.
items.evidence: Initialize seeded `| (none) | — |`; validator warned on turns 36, 39, and 46 that deferred content was inconsistent.
items.skill_search: Compared Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 no-item output with Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 no-item recognition.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Validator recognized only the phrase `No items deferred`, not the bootstrap table sentinel.
items.root_cause: Producer and consumer used different sentinel formats.
items.proposed_fix: Teach the validator to recognize the bootstrap's `(none)` row.
items.generalizes: Every migration with zero deferred files otherwise emits the same false warning.
